title: Chess, But You Can't Look at SCP-096
summary: Standard chess vs Stockfish with a visible neutral SCP-096 (Shy Guy) on a4. Shy Guy captures any piece of either colour that attacks ('looks at') his square by moving onto it; if several pieces attack him he picks one at random. He then sits on the new square and is triggered again by whatever attacks him there, so chains of captures can be engineered toward a king. Game 1: Shy Guy acts after every single ply - narrator lures him into Black's camp via a knight sac on d7 (queen recaptures, Shy Guy eats the queen). Game 2: Shy Guy acts only once per full round; narrator still wins when Shy Guy reaches the black king.
rules: Standard chess otherwise; player White vs Stockfish (3600).
Neutral SCP-096 starts on a4 (e.g. 1.c4 would open the d1-a4 diagonal so the queen 'looks' at him).
Trigger: any piece (either colour) whose attack covers Shy Guy's square; Shy Guy captures that piece by moving onto its square; multiple attackers -> random choice.
He cannot otherwise move; he cannot be captured (attacking him gets the attacker eaten).
Game 1 timing: Shy Guy resolves after every ply; Game 2 timing: once per full round (after both sides moved).
If Shy Guy captures a king, that side loses.
win_condition: Checkmate Stockfish or have Shy Guy capture the black king (both games won).
